item.title: Volcanic eruption in Iceland forces Grindavik residents to flee
item.description: Lava fountains lit up the sky above the Reykjanes peninsula as Icelandic authorities ordered Grindavik evacuated for the second time this year.
item.dc:creator: Test Reporter
